headline: Congress keeps things light with back-to-back pro forma sessions as August winds down.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on Thursday, August 20, lasting just 40 seconds. No substantive business was conducted, with the chamber adjourning until the following Monday.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met for just 3 minutes on Thursday, August 20, with no votes recorded. Twenty new bills and one resolution were introduced, while eight bills received committee reports clearing them for potential floor consideration.
